elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Where TrueLink processes data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Client, it must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must provide certificates of insurance to Client on request.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required USD 2,000,000 professional liability (errors and omissions) coverage exceeds the USD 1,000,000 fallback minimum.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause requires USD 5,000,000 of cyber and privacy coverage only where TrueLink processes specified Client-related data; it does not impose the fallback element's unconditional coverage requirement.
